propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently runs only in the standalone prompt-eval.yml workflow, which does not gate the Verified vote or block Gerrit submit.
The eval-spec glob validation and strict checks (validate_eval_spec with strict=True) exist only as an inline CI script step, with no corresponding unit test in the default pytest suite.
Dataset-bearing eval specs (e.g., asserted-capability, decomp-shape, necessity) can merge with an empty or missing gold_set because the validation does not gate the Verified vote.

A unit test added to tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py that globs all packaged eval specs and asserts both validate_eval_spec(spec) and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) will run in the default suite and gate the Verified vote pre-merge.
The inline validation step in prompt-eval.yml becomes redundant once the unit test is in place and collected by the default suite.
The test must fail if any dataset-bearing packaged spec lacks a gold_set or has unregistered scorers or unbalanced dataset.
